paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.92, with a change of -0.84% from the prior close and -10.03% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 21, 2026.

Other news includes the appointment of Lee McIntire as interim CEO and construction underway at the Project Matador campus in Texas.
